user.title: Connect to Energy Ingest
user.description: Enter your Energy Ingest server address and the Home Assistant API token created during Energy Ingest setup. Find the token in the protected setup output or request a replacement from the Energy Ingest administrator. No time-zone conversion is needed.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Energy Ingest API token
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a replacement Home Assistant API token generated by the Energy Ingest administrator. Existing tokens cannot be retrieved in plaintext.

reconfigure.title: Update Energy Ingest connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the server URL and a valid API token. Use this form after reinstalling Energy Ingest or rotating the API token. Changing to a different server is not supported.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Energy Ingest. Check the server address and network connection.

abort.already_configured: This Energy Ingest server is already configured.
